title: Context-addressed performance artifacts exceeded Factorio's Windows path boundary

reproduction.error: Performance probe marker is absent from the baseline warmup factorio.log.
reproduction.observed: The context-addressed probe data.lua path was 251 characters and loaded, while data-final-fixes.lua was 263 characters and Factorio silently omitted that stage.
reproduction.isolation: The exact failed staged mods were copied to a unique C:\tmp smoke root. At a 103-character probe final-fixes path, Factorio 2.1.12 loaded the stage and emitted the structured MIR_PERFORMANCE_PROBE marker.

root_cause.summary: The executor passed the long immutable-context evidence directory directly to Factorio as its write and mod root. The semantic context address is required for retained evidence, but it is not safe as a Windows engine execution path. The final-fixes filename crossed Factorio's effective legacy path boundary even though PowerShell could create and inspect the file.

regression_propositions: the executor creates a fresh compact scratch root bound to the exact immutable context
the longest exact-package probe final-fixes path remains at or below the conservative 240-character budget
scratch roots are never overwritten or merged
raw run artifacts are relocated to the context-addressed evidence tree after engine execution
the relocated marker must bind the same context and execution-root strategy
the exact failed staged mods emit the final structured probe marker from a compact path

repair_proof.result: C21 and C24 both emitted mir-performance-regression-probe

closure.proof_required: fresh exact paired performance measurement and complete C24 calibration under a new immutable context
